painPoints.title: Complex Quote Configuration Management
painPoints.description: Ntirety's sales team struggles with manual quote configuration for complex hybrid cloud solutions, leading to longer sales cycles and increased errors in pricing configurations across multiple hosting tiers and service bundles.

painPoints.title: Lack of Real-time Pricing Visibility
painPoints.description: Current CPQ system lacks real-time integration with dynamic pricing models and inventory management, causing quote delays, outdated pricing information, and reduced ability to respond quickly to competitive opportunities.

opportunities.title: Accelerated Sales Cycle Through Automated Quote Generation
opportunities.description: Implementing CloudSense CPQ automation can reduce quote generation time by 60%, enabling faster customer responses, improved win rates, and increased sales team productivity for Ntirety's enterprise hosting solutions.

opportunities.title: Enhanced Revenue Recognition and Upsell Capabilities
opportunities.description: CloudSense CPQ's advanced bundling and recommendation engine can identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities, improving average contract value by 25-35% across managed hosting, security, and compliance service offerings.
